data.name: ALIGNMENT : An Engineering Odyssey
data.detailed_description:
Real terrain. Real geometry. Real consequences.

<ALIGNMENT: Engineering Odyssey> is a hardcore infrastructure simulation driven by authentic topography. Every project unfolds in a distinct geographic setting—mountain passes, river valleys, coastal corridors, urban fringes. The land itself dictates your constraints and shapes the visceral experience behind the wheel. There are no abstract grids here. Every ridge, every ravine is a boundary you must confront.

Core Features

Real Geographic Environments (GIS Integration)

Engineering-Grade Design

Drive to Validate

Workflow

Survey – Interpret the terrain. Identify control points and constraints.

Align – Plan horizontal and vertical geometry. Balance earthwork.

Construct – Build interactively: pavement structure, slope stabilization, bridge placement, tunnel portals, interchange ramps.

Verify – Drive the finished route. Gather feedback through the wheel and pedals.

Iterate – Revise the design. Fix the flaws.

Localization

More than text translation—terminology is adapted to match regional engineering standards and conventions.

Launch languages: Simplified Chinese · Traditional Chinese · English · Japanese

Expansion: German · French · Spanish · Korean · Italian · Dutch · Portuguese · Russian

Community priority: Swedish · Norwegian · Danish · Finnish

During Early Access

More real-world sites

Engineering systems

Driving experience

Performance and scale

Language support

Long-Term Exploration

The following directions are still in the planning phase, guided by community feedback.

Corridor planning

Complex structures

Dynamic traffic

data.short_description: A professional-grade road design sim built on real-world maps. Recreate complex interchanges and iconic highways 1:1, engineer custom solutions with real workflows, and drive what you design.
data.supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 12GB / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT 12GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
